def quarterData(trade: pd.DataFrame, low: tuple, high: tuple) -> list:
    """
    输入日期型字符串,返回日期范围内的销量和用户量
    """
    from datetime import datetime
    low = datetime.strptime(low, "%Y/%m/%d")
    high = datetime.strptime(high, "%Y/%m/%d")
    trade_low = trade[(trade.day >= datetime(low.year, low.month, low.day)) & (
        trade.day <= datetime(high.year, high.month, high.day))]
    group_low = trade_low[['buy_mount', 'day', 'user_id']].groupby(
        by=[trade_low.day.dt.month, trade_low.day.dt.day])
    mount = group_low.buy_mount.sum()
    user = group_low.user_id.nunique()

    return [mount, user]

def lineMountUser(mount, user, title):
    """
    输入销量和用户量数据以及标题，生成折线图
    """
    plot = pyc.Line().add_xaxis(xaxis_data=[str(x[0])+"/"+str(x[1]) for x in mount.index]
                                ).add_yaxis(series_name="销量", y_axis=[int(x) for x in mount.values], markline_opts=opts.MarkLineOpts(data=[opts.MarkLineItem(name='当月销量均值', type_="average")])
                                            ).add_yaxis(series_name="用户量", y_axis=[int(x) for x in user.values], markline_opts=opts.MarkLineOpts(data=[opts.MarkLineItem(name='当月用户量量均值', type_="average")])
                                                        ).set_series_opts(label_opts=opts.LabelOpts(is_show=False)
                                                                          ).set_global_opts(title_opts=opts.TitleOpts(title=title), toolbox_opts=opts.ToolboxOpts(), tooltip_opts=opts.TooltipOpts(trigger='axis')
                                                                                            ).render_notebook()
    return plot

def cmonthPurchaseRate(data):
    """
    导入根据月和userid分组数据
    """
    rate = []
    for i in range(1, 13):
        cmonth_bought_user = data.size()[[i]].sum()
        cmonth_repurchase_user = (data.size()[[i]] > 1).sum()
        rate.append(round(cmonth_repurchase_user/cmonth_bought_user, 4))
    return rate

本步运行工程适配器，展示真实输入的质量、专属聚合与图表。清洗、分组和模型边界见代码与每份结果说明。教学代码为本项目经过审查的实现；不会执行原Notebook。

def p19(p):
 d=p.load('(sample)sam_tianchi_mum_baby_trade_history.csv',dtype={'user_id':str,'auction_id':str,'cat_id':str,'cat1':str});baby=p.load('(sample)sam_tianchi_mum_baby.csv',dtype={'user_id':str});c=d[d.buy_mount.between(1,195)].copy();assert len(c)==29942 and int(c.buy_mount.sum())==49973
 c['月份']=pd.to_datetime(c.day.astype(str),format='%Y%m%d').dt.strftime('%Y-%m');g=c.groupby('月份').buy_mount.sum().reset_index();p.chart('monthly','月购买量趋势',g,kind='line',unit='原buy_mount计量',note='无单价字段，不称销售额；日期不同覆盖长度影响比较')
 p.chart('category','商品大类购买量',c.groupby('cat1').buy_mount.sum().reset_index(),note='cat1是类别标签；不当连续数轴',unit='原buy_mount计量');g=c.groupby(['月份','user_id']).size().rename('购买记录数').reset_index();rate=g.groupby('月份').购买记录数.agg(当月用户数='size',重复用户数=lambda s:int((s>1).sum())).reset_index();rate['复购用户比例']=rate.重复用户数/rate.当月用户数
 p.chart('repurchase','同月有两条以上购买记录的用户比例',rate[['月份','复购用户比例','当月用户数','重复用户数']],kind='line',note='按月份和user_id计记录；用户去重作分母，不把记录比例当用户比例',unit='比例0—1',denominator='每月样本中不同user_id数量')
 p.add('coverage','交易与婴儿表覆盖',['统计项','值'],[['交易原行',len(d)],['清洗后行',len(c)],['购买量',int(c.buy_mount.sum())],['婴儿表行',len(baby)],['交易中可在婴儿表匹配的用户数',len(set(c.user_id)&set(baby.user_id))]],'两表覆盖不同，不能把婴儿表953人当全部买家，也没有年龄预测。',unit='记录 / 用户 / 原购买量');p.checks.update(clean=len(c),quantity=int(c.buy_mount.sum()))
limitations: 两表覆盖不同，婴儿表953人，代码并未实现年龄预测；无单价不能计算营业额；原文将销量称销售额、日期有笔误；节日原因是推测；抽样不支持全国市场规模或质量归因。
新版本不覆盖原保存成绩；所有新训练均在构建清单中单列。

def quarterData(trade: pd.DataFrame, low: tuple, high: tuple) -> list:
    """
    输入日期型字符串,返回日期范围内的销量和用户量
    """
    from datetime import datetime
    low = datetime.strptime(low, "%Y/%m/%d")
    high = datetime.strptime(high, "%Y/%m/%d")
    trade_low = trade[(trade.day >= datetime(low.year, low.month, low.day)) & (
        trade.day <= datetime(high.year, high.month, high.day))]
    group_low = trade_low[['buy_mount', 'day', 'user_id']].groupby(
        by=[trade_low.day.dt.month, trade_low.day.dt.day])
    mount = group_low.buy_mount.sum()
    user = group_low.user_id.nunique()

    return [mount, user]
